params.topic: Swiss Super League nine unresolved Bet365 true-opening 1X2 fields, fixture-level evidence only
params.execution_note: This is a narrow follow-up to req-20261012-002, whose broad audit found structural text-layer limits. Search only the nine fixtures listed below. Do not repeat a league-wide audit or retry any source before its DEAD-END REGISTRY retry_after date. The 5Dollar API targeted attempts are exhausted and must not be called again. Dispatch independent fixture searches in parallel under the ai-data-bus SOP, then merge row-level evidence without resolving conflicts.
questions: For each listed Swiss Super League regular-season fixture, identify the exact fixture using season, Swiss-local date, and ordered home/away teams. Return stable source fixture IDs where available and exact official/archived fixture URLs. Do not use fuzzy team/date matching; do not substitute another match returned by a search page.

For each exact fixture, search accessible independent historical odds archives for Bet365 1X2 true opening odds. Accept a value only when the source explicitly identifies bookmaker Bet365 (or a documented Bet365 alias), market 1X2, and opening/initial phase, with complete home/draw/away values. Return the three values only with direct source evidence. Do not treat closing, current, pre-close, a single unspecified snapshot, or another bookmaker as opening.

Return one row for every target fixture even when no opening odds are found. Each row must include record_key, season, local_date, ordered home_team and away_team, SFL_Spielnummer when supplied, provider_fixture_id if found, bookmaker, market, phase, home/draw/away values or null, status (ok/unavailable/blocked/conflict/parse_failed), source_url, final_url, retrieved_at with timezone, field_locator, source_sha256, and a concise source-specific reason. Preserve conflicting candidate values and provenance; do not choose a winner.

For failed searches, state which sources were checked and why each failed, while respecting registered retry_after restrictions. Do not call 5DollarFootballAPI again. Do not report an unrelated fixture's odds as a match. No score, goals, result, standings, Qimen, model, Snapshot, Outcome, Review, Gold, probability, or weight fields are requested or allowed.

Include an audit with expected=9, discovered exact fixtures, complete Bet365 opening triplets, partial evidence, and missing count, plus an unresolved_queue listing every unresolved record_key and source-specific reason. Preserve nulls and do not invent data.
